rationale: Correct Valia Energía's headquarters from an asset-footprint string to the documented corporate headquarters in Mexico City, add the official company website, and record the 2026-08-03 verification date. Preserve the canonical identity, active status, Mexico geography, operating description, 3.2 GW platform scale, Actis Energy 5 ownership beginning in 2022, and undisclosed stake. Link the initial investment milestone to Actis' acquisition-closing announcement and make the current Actis portfolio page the primary ownership citation. A fresh acquisition-and-exit check confirms Actis still marks Valia as current and stated in May 2026 that it had no short-term plans to exit; no signed sale or completed disposition was found.

beforeImage.name: Valia Energía
beforeImage.subsector: Independent power generation and gas transportation
beforeImage.description: Valia Energía is a Mexican independent power producer operating natural gas-fired combined-cycle generation assets and a related gas pipeline. Its customers are power purchasers in Mexico's electricity market and other users of reliable dispatchable generation rather than retail end users. The operating model is asset-heavy and infrastructure based, with cash flows tied to large-scale generating plants and associated fuel transportation assets. Actis and company materials state that the platform has 3.2 GW of installed capacity across seven plants and a 58-kilometer gas pipeline. Actis created the platform in 2022 through the acquisition of MT Falcon and expanded it in 2023 through the acquisition of EVM Energia; the current ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed.
beforeImage.headquarters: Tamaulipas, Coahuila, and State of Mexico
